extracted.name: Best Egg Salad Recipe
extracted.description: This egg salad recipe will become one of your favorite lunches! I love it on a sandwich, with crackers, over lettuce, or straight from the bowl.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup finely diced red onion
instruction_lines: Hard boil the eggs according to this recipe. Peel and chop.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, salt, and several grinds of pepper.
Mix in the onions, then fold in the eggs, chives, and dill.
Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 20 minutes. Stir, then season to taste and serve.
